description: Expose a local port on a public URL (https://<subdomain>.otterkit.app). Runs as a background daemon. Costs 1 credit per connected hour (never more than 300 credits/30 days). Set capture=true to also log every request for requests_list/request_await/request_replay.

auth.description: Require HTTP Basic auth as "user:pass" (enforced locally, never sent to servers)

capture.description: Also capture requests to the local log

ttl.description: Auto-stop after e.g. 4h, 3d (default 24h, or "never" to run until stopped)

name: tunnel_create
title: Create tunnel to localhost
